title: Fully Foliage!
description: Adds over 40 new plants to MINECRAFT, along with three woodsets, and more!
body:
Welcome to Fully Foliage, your new Minecraft Plant Mod! This mod contains over 40 new plants, such as clovers, cornflowers, blackcurrant, and more, as well as three new woodsets, baobab, ginkgo, and citrus, and even new foods like limes, oranges, nuts and salt-baked goods. With a few new biomes in both the overworld and the Nether, as well as plants or woods for both, as well as wxpansions to the forests, plains, pale gardens, and more, this mod has it all. With the cache for convinience, and roses for genius, no matter what plat you want, it is likely here. Also, all music discs are made by me, Ojhamos melons. Thank you for enjoying FULLY FOLIAGE!
![The logo, stating, "FULLY FOLIAGE."](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f487e80d9f0963a2c658fd4d3d2903e800d124c.png)
